commands.label: exact-candidate-projections
argv:
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from math_gauge.catalog import Suite,candidate_message
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);work=Path(sys.argv[2]);suite=Suite.load(root/'cases');rows=[]
for cid,category in (('MG-GP003','proofs'),('MG-GF101','lean-audit')):
 case_root=root/'cases'/category/cid;case=json.loads((case_root/'case.json').read_text());out=work/'prepared'/cid
 request=json.loads((out/'request.json').read_text());task=(case_root/case['task']).read_bytes()
 instruction=case['candidate_instruction'];files=[{'name':x['target'],'content':(case_root/x['source']).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')} for x in case['solver_files']]
 assert request=={'schema':'math-gauge.request/v1','case_id':cid,'case_version':case['version'],'track':case['track'],
                 'instruction':instruction,'task':task.decode('utf-8'),'files':files}
 prompt=(instruction+'\n\n').encode()+task if instruction else task
 assert (out/'prompt.md').read_bytes()==prompt
 expected={'prompt.md','request.json'}|{x['target'] for x in case['solver_files']}
 actual={p.relative_to(out).as_posix() for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file()};assert actual==expected
 for item in case['solver_files']:assert (out/item['target']).read_bytes()==(case_root/item['source']).read_bytes()
 message=candidate_message(request)
 if cid=='MG-GP003':assert message.encode()==task and files==[] and not instruction
 rows.append({'case_id':cid,'request_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'request.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
  'task_sha256':hashlib.sha256(task).hexdigest(),'prompt_sha256':hashlib.sha256(prompt).hexdigest(),
  'candidate_message_sha256':hashlib.sha256(message.encode()).hexdigest(),'candidate_file_names':sorted(expected),
  'exact_projection_verified':True,'no_evaluator_files_exported':True})
print(json.dumps(rows))
